title: AI军备竞赛新玩家：4亿美元押注红杉系公司，硅谷新贵能否持续搅局
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It has been reported that we were talking with them about the Anthropic Stake.
segments.zh: 据报道，我们曾与他们讨论过Anthropic的股份。

segments.en: You know, King Griffin showed up with what was a better solution for Beopold at that moment in time and he went with the better solution.
segments.zh: 你知道，格里芬当时提出了一个对Beopold更好的方案，他选择了更好的方案。

segments.en: I think that our observation is that there is this game on the field over the last couple of years investing the AI supply chain.
segments.zh: 我认为我们的观察是，过去几年在AI供应链**上存在这样的博弈。

segments.en: Beopold was one of the first people to recognize that that was the game on the field and on balance, he played it pretty darn well.
segments.zh: Beopold是最早认识到这一博弈的人之一，总体而言，他玩得相当不错。

segments.en: And so our suspicion is that he's going to be a fixture in Silicon Valley for a long time to come.
segments.zh: 因此我们怀疑，他将在硅谷长期占据一席之地。

segments.en: I wanted to get to the Valar case study. We've talked a bit about Sean.
segments.zh: 我想谈谈Valar的案例研究。我们已经聊过一些关于Sean的事情。

segments.en: Can we please go ahead? On situational awareness? He did just wire $400 million a company that we invested in.
segments.zh: 我们继续吧？关于情境意识，他刚刚向一家我们**的公司注资4亿美元。

segments.en: Oh, because we actually reported on the $400 million but haven't got a clue.
segments.zh: 哦，因为我们确实报道过这4亿美元，但不知道是哪家公司。

segments.en: The company is. Yeah, no comment on that.
segments.zh: 公司是？是的，对此不予置评。

segments.en: But he's not. It's a good one. He's going to be really good.
segments.zh: 但他不是。这是个好项目。他会做得很好。
